content:
Formalized the combinatorics behind Gurevich–Lapid's RSK correspondence paper in Lean: https://github.com/elazarg/rsk.

Core combinatorial theorem chain is fully proved on Mathlib's baseline axioms. Highlights:

  • Lemma 5.5(3) is false as stated (counterexample + corrected boundary case).
  • Filled a real gap behind Prop 2.4's "easy to see" inverse claim. It is one of the heaviest proofs in the formalization.

Along the way, also proved the full weighted Greene's theorem for the Burge Correspondence (Krattenthaler/Rubey). A small optional tableau-duality subsystem still has two open gates (documented in the README).

I have not verified the definitions by hand.
